content.value_statement: Backend teams need fast context on API entry points, RAG flows, and service dependencies. This skill explains the FastAPI structure, request flow, and required environment settings.
actual_capabilities: Identifies the FastAPI entry point and default local server port.
Explains the chat endpoint request, retrieval, prompt, and response flow.
Explains selected-text question handling and selection validation.
Lists backend utility modules for Qdrant setup, embeddings, and prompt building.
Documents required environment variables for Gemini and Qdrant services.
limitations: Does not include the backend source code or endpoint implementation details.
Does not validate schemas, dependencies, or runtime behavior.
Does not configure API keys, Qdrant collections, or deployment settings.
Does not replace application security review or integration testing.

use_cases.title: Onboard Backend Developers
use_cases.description: Understand an existing FastAPI service before making endpoint changes.

use_cases.title: Plan Technical Handoffs
use_cases.description: Review backend responsibilities and dependencies during project handoff planning.

use_cases.title: Prepare Architecture Notes
use_cases.description: Create concise backend documentation for onboarding and support workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize the Backend
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to summarize the FastAPI backend entry point, endpoints, dependencies, and environment variables.

prompt_templates.title: Trace a Chat Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to trace what happens when a user calls the chat endpoint, from request fields to response content.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an Endpoint Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to identify which backend modules and request models I should inspect before changing selected-text question handling.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Review Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a backend review brief covering RAG flow, Qdrant integration, model setup, risks, and validation checks.

output_examples.output: The chat endpoint accepts a query, history, and user context. It embeds the query, searches Qdrant, builds a prompt, and returns an answer with contexts.

output_examples.input: What should I check before changing selected-text question handling?
output_examples.output: Review selection length validation, the selection-specific prompt builder, and the response path for targeted answers.
Start the FastAPI app on the documented port and provide Gemini and Qdrant connection settings through the environment.

best_practices: Use the skill to orient around architecture before editing backend code.
Confirm endpoint behavior against the live source before shipping changes.
Keep API keys in environment variables and never place secrets in prompts.
anti_patterns: Treating the documentation as a full source-code audit.
Changing endpoint contracts without checking request and response models.
Sharing real Gemini or Qdrant credentials during troubleshooting.

faq.question: Which backend framework does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers a FastAPI backend for chatbot and RAG workflows.

faq.question: What endpoints are described?
faq.answer: It describes chat and selected-text question endpoints.

faq.question: Does it execute backend commands?
faq.answer: No. It documents a local run command, but the skill itself does not execute commands.

faq.question: Does it include secret values?
faq.answer: No. It names required environment variables without including any credential values.

faq.question: Can it help with onboarding?
faq.answer: Yes. It gives developers a compact map of entry points, utilities, and request flow.

faq.question: Can it replace reading the source code?
faq.answer: No. Use it as a guide, then verify behavior in the actual backend files.
